description: The bar chart illustrates the number of participants who selected each criterion when evaluating a generative-AI-driven claim retrieval system, as described in the paper titled “A Generative-AI-Driven Claim Retrieval System Capable of Detecting and Retrieving Claims from Social Media Platforms in Multiple Languages.” The horizontal axis represents the “Number of Participants,” ranging from 0 to 6 in increments of 2, while the vertical axis lists six evaluation criteria: “FC Summary,” “Relevance Explanation,” “Clarity and Simplicity,” “Overall Summary,” “Filters,” and “Veracity Explanation.” Each criterion is represented by a horizontal bar with a distinct color and labeled with its corresponding participant count. “FC Summary” received the highest selection with 6 participants (dark purple bar), followed by “Relevance Explanation” with 5 participants (dark blue bar). “Clarity and Simplicity” and “Overall Summary” were each selected by 3 and 2 participants respectively (teal and green bars). The least selected criteria, “Filters” and “Veracity Explanation,” were each chosen by only 1 participant (light green and lime bars). The bars are arranged in descending order of participant count, visually emphasizing the relative importance or preference assigned to each criterion by the participants.
